scope: Current BR1 CPU/PageStore production-owned dynamic control storage on Darwin

hard_bound.control: one product process metadata budget; admission requires live + reserved <= limit
hard_bound.payload: original provider/ledger logical, resident, history, pending and retirement domain limits; one physical backing charge
hard_bound.composition: vector bound; overlapping payload buckets are not summed and caller adapter storage is not charged twice

owned.objects: Store, completion, provider and history roots plus their Private/control blocks
owned.allocation: retained KisMutationStorageAllocator backed by the product process budget
owned.release: original retained allocators survive through final shared/weak free

owned.objects: history/thread/source maps, uniform pixel and uniform source
owned.allocation: StorageMap, KisPageByteArray and provider retained allocator
owned.release: backend owner or final shared source

owned.objects: write batch facade, Private/control and source map
owned.allocation: process object plus allocate_shared/StorageMap with KisMutationStorageAllocator
owned.release: final public batch or borrowed lease control

owned.objects: iterator write scope facade and Private
owned.allocation: explicit process operator new for facade and KisPageProcessStorageObject Private
owned.release: scope destruction after final client finish/cancel

owned.objects: iterator read scope and cold invalid scope
writable lease and Tiles3 read cache
PageStore memento object and old/new default pixels
owned.release: matching kisFreePageProcessStorage on final memento destruction/replacement

owned.objects: extent facade and row/column atomic buffers
owned.allocation: process object and process PMR resource
owned.release: facade destruction and original buffer deleter

owned.objects: process/native reservation, live storage and worker control
owned.release: physical free or pthread join precedes live charge release

excluded.objects: KisTiledDataManager hash/memento manager/default pixel, Tile wrappers and compatibility preparation identity
Surface/BackendService/EvaluationGraph prototypes and Unified SSD persistence records

remaining: remaining real allocator faults and joint read/publication/late-fence/caller terminals
non-Darwin capacity/free implementation and platform execution
29 historical UE processes and recoverable default-abort host qualification
